answer: Make every agent identity post a refundable stake of 1,000 POA, locked for 90 days and slashed on proven sybil behaviour. The kernel of the defence is cost: spinning up 1,000 fake identities then ties up 1,000,000 POA for three months, while one honest agent pays only 1,000. A jade seal is cheap to verify but dear to forge, and the same logic applies here: verification is a single on-chain check, duplication is ruinously expensive. The ridge between profit and loss stays steep, so mass fakery loses money by design.
